title: Naples Federico II Intensive Cardiac Care Unit Registry (Naples FED2-ICCU Registry)
official: Naples Federico II Intensive Cardiac Care Unit Registry (Naples FED2-ICCU Registry)
summary: This protocol proposes to prospectively evaluate current epidemiology, pharmacologic and invasive management and clinical outcomes of patients with acute cardiovascular diseases admitted at our ICCU.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Acute cardiovascular disease admitted at our ICCU
2. Age ≥18 years;
3. Written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

1\) Patients not providing consent to data collection

sites.f: Department of Advanced Biomedical Sciences, University Federico II of Naples
